extraction.name: TextVQA
extraction.description: TextVQA contains 45,336 questions asked by humans on 28,408 images from the Open Images dataset that require reading and reasoning about text in the image to answer.
extraction.creator: Amanpreet Singh; Vivek Natarajan; Meet Shah; Yu Jiang; Xinlei Chen; Dhruv Batra; Devi Parikh; Marcus Rohrbach
extraction.citeAs: Amanpreet Singh, Vivek Natarajan, Meet Shah, Yu Jiang, Xinlei Chen, Dhruv Batra, Devi Parikh, Marcus Rohrbach. Towards VQA Models That Can Read. arXiv:1904.08920v2 [cs.CL] 13 May 2019
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were sampled from the Open Images v3 dataset using category weights based on OCR bounding box frequency. A three-stage crowdsourcing pipeline was then used where human annotators filtered out images without text, wrote questions requiring reading the text, and provided answers.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images from the Open Images v3 dataset.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: A three-stage crowdsourcing pipeline where annotators first identified images without text, then provided 1-2 questions per image requiring reading text to answer, and finally provided answers. Quality control included filtering questions flagged by a majority of workers and using hand-crafted questions with known answers to identify and filter out bad annotators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Questions flagged by a majority of workers as invalid (e.g., no text, not a question, unanswerable) were removed, and the most common (majority) answer among the annotators was used.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset does not have significant biases w.r.t. images and questions.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The OCR model fails at detecting text that is rotated, unstructured (e.g., a scribble), or partially occluded; the model can only produce one OCR token as the predicted answer, meaning it cannot answer the 8.9% of TextVQA questions that require combining multiple OCR tokens; the OCR system sometimes fails to detect text in images that actually contain it.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset addresses a specific skill in Visual Question Answering that is important for applications involving aiding visually impaired users with their assistive devices.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmark progress along directions complementary to VQA 2.0; Encourage research on improving text detection and recognition in unconstrained environments; Enable VQA models to read and reason about text in images.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images that did not contain text and noisy data from annotators were filtered out. Questions where a majority of workers marked flags (no text in image, not a question, answering doesn't require reading text, or unanswerable) were removed. Additionally, hand-crafted questions with known correct answers were used to identify and filter out bad annotators.
